objective: Falsify quotient-respecting absolute base-trace richness scores at zero counted intersection cost in the exact graph generator family before any explicit hard-graph scoring.
problem_signature: graph generator family G_{N,N} of rows and columns
cyclic intersection complexity counts intersections only

v3_features_used: experience-conditioned routing as search priority only

pin_freshness: STALE_RELATIVE_TO_CURRENT_RAKL_MAIN; newer gates applied manually and no weaker pinned gate is treated as authority
structural_coordinates: G_{N,N} consists of all N rows and N columns
A=R_1 is nontrivial for N>=2 and is itself a generator
U(B) is the finite union closure of the generator family
T_A={C intersect A : C in U(B)} is the zero-cost base trace family on A
equivalent_representations: T_A equals the set of traces on the first row generated by free column unions
full shattering of A is equivalent to T_A=P(A)
